purpose: Index committed public-safe human adjudication fixture families for deterministic reporting and regression checks.
scope: Public-safe adjudication JSONL fixtures under traces/external/.
Existing scored traces referenced by those adjudications.
Deterministic local reporting and regression checks only.

No live Hermes, OpenClaw, or production-system execution.
No browser, email, messaging, purchase, file mutation, or other external actions.
No credentials, secrets, network calls, or private runtime integration.
